class: A builder's report describes a change (and reasons about why it failed) that exists only in its own worktree's uncommitted state or was reverted, not on the pushed branch; the orchestrator plans the next round on a branch that does not contain what the report says.
mechanism: W-095 round 3's report said the Pro grant was recorded through entitlement_store.append and explained why it could not work (grant stamped 2026-10-17 vs a test clock of 2026-10-16). The pushed head 11c2aef carried no grant code; the builder's worktree held only an uncommitted execute_plan.py change. Found by the independent investigator, who read the branch instead of the report.

first_seen.evidence: investigator: 'HEAD 11c2aef records no Pro grant at all ... grep for entitle|grant in the test file: no hits; builder worktree status: only backend/ofo_app/execute_plan.py modified'; agentwt.py release of that worktree -> 'REFUSED: dirty or unpushed'

fix: Every builder brief's report asks for `git status --short` (must be empty) and the pushed head sha; the orchestrator checks `agentwt.py <id> status` (dirty / on_origin) before reading the report as describing the branch. Applied from W-095 round 4's brief ('git status must be clean before you report').

detection.note: agentwt.py status shows dirty / on_origin, but nothing forces it to be read before a report is relayed. Candidate: the orchestrator's report intake runs it automatically.

occurrences.evidence: report described a grant attempt absent from the pushed branch
